description: Category search with pre-computed rankings for broad queries such as 'gaming laptop', '85 inch tv' or 'air fryer': returns the top-ranked products with short review summaries and matching best-picks guides. Use it for open-ended 'what should I buy' questions; use product_search for a specific product name and product_lookup for an exact identifier, then product_offers for prices. Free without an API key; with a key, 2 credits plus 1 per product review and 1 per guide included. If nothing ranks for the query, say so; do not invent products.

include_best_picks.description: Include matching best picks articles (default: true)

include_reviews.description: Include TLDR review summaries in results (default: true)

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'gaming laptop', '85 inch tv', 'running shoes', 'air fryer')

name: universal_search
title: Ranked category search
